caption_L1: Here a is a line plot labeled Japan : Distribution of the workforce across economic sectors from 2010 to 2020. The x-axis shows Year with a linear scale from 2010 to 2018. A linear scale with a minimum of 0.00 and a maximum of 0.04 can be found on the y-axis, marked Agriculture.
caption_L2L3: Between 2000 and 2010 the proportion of the workforce working in agriculture has decreased from just over 4% (0.04) in 2010 to around 3.3% in 2020. Year on year the proportion of the workforce working in agriculture decreased, except in 2018 where the proportion of the workforce in agriculture increased from the 2017 proportion.
